name: Kings Corners
tagline: Solitaire for everyone: build down in red and black, kings in the corners, first out wins.
rulesSummary: Seven cards each. Four cards turned up around the stock start the North, East, South and West piles.
On your turn make as many plays as you like, then draw a card to end your turn.
Play a card onto a pile if it's one lower and the other colour (a red 6 on a black 7). Aces are low: nothing goes on an ace.
Kings go into the empty corners to start new piles. Any card can fill an empty North, East, South or West space.
Move a whole pile onto another when its bottom card fits on that pile's top card. Select a card, then tap the pile it goes on.
Play your last card to win the hand. Others score a penalty: 10 for each king left, 1 for any other card. Lowest total wins when someone reaches the target.
